boundaries: Native in-process Request, not actual HTTP through a proxy or Next.
Authentication, CSRF, authorization and rate limiting not executed.
Synthetic fixtures <= 100 KiB; no memory or availability benchmark.
Understated Content-Length is a Web Request model, not proof that an HTTP server accepts inconsistent framing.
R15 concerns parse order and missing application-level total-body limit; deployment exploitability remains unverified.
Actual host FFmpeg 7.1.5 differs from declared Docker FFmpeg 8.0.1; production not inspected.
Four synthetic XML/MP4 candidates only; no exhaustive malformed-media corpus or SSRF absence proof.
Metadata/sniff are pure functions; HTTP/R2/complete-upload path not executed.
Only own ephemeral loopback fixture was targeted; no external or production network.
Process limits tested with bounded benign Node children, not a demonstrated FFmpeg hang.
No full encode, image RCE exploit, quality or capacity benchmark.
